sql.label: webhooks
sql.query: SELECT id::text, url, is_active::text, secret_key FROM webhooks ORDER BY id::text

sql.label: webhook_logs
sql.query: SELECT workspace_id::text, webhook::text, COALESCE(event_type, 'NULL'), COALESCE(request_method, 'NULL'), COALESCE(request_headers, 'NULL'), COALESCE(request_body, 'NULL'), COALESCE(response_status, 'NULL'), COALESCE(response_headers, 'NULL'), COALESCE(response_body, 'NULL'), retry_count::text FROM webhook_logs ORDER BY webhook::text, request_method
